# 2 Baruch Chapter 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** The Lord said to me: "Baruch, I have heard your prayer. Your grief has not gone unnoticed.

**2** But here is what I tell you: anyone who can hold on through suffering without abandoning me will receive a crown.

**3** You have mourned deeply for Zion, and that grief has weighed on you.

**4** Now, do not let the prosperity of the nations disturb your heart, or they will have gotten the better of you.

**5** The nations will be held accountable when the time comes — punished according to their sins, on schedule.

**6** As for you, keep your focus away from the nations and keep your own works in view. Your reward will be measured by what you have done.

**7** I will not forget the covenant I made with your ancestors, and those who have died will not be forgotten by me.

**8** What the Most High has in store for those who live righteously at the right time — it is beyond measure.

**9** A lamp that lights a room goes out when it is no longer needed. But the light of the righteous shines on forever.

**10** So take courage and get ready. Keep trusting me, keep believing in me. I am the Mighty One. I will not hide my face from you.

**11** Morning light will come to you after the darkness. God's salvation comes to those who wait for it.

**12** So prepare yourself for what is coming, and remember what has been spoken about you. Because from Zion the Law will go out, and from Jerusalem the word of the Lord."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. V.2 "hold on through suffering" for "endure tribulation." V.8 "beyond measure" amplifies the implied superlative. V.12 quotes Isa 2:3/Mic 4:2 in accessible language.*
